The lines are in another language and won't show these words: choose them yourself from the two people's ages and relationship, as Hungarian speakers normally would. Not just "formal" or "informal". Add what changes if their relationship changes during the story. Skip this only if Hungarian has no such distinctions.
NAMES: names of people, places and things that must stay spelled the same.
Under PEOPLE, write only what the lines support, and "unknown" where they don't say. Start directly with PEOPLE, no introduction.

You're a jerk, Thom.

you have your robotics, and I just want to be awesome in space.

...by these giant robotic claws of death...
Whatever, Thom. We're done.
